label: Depreciation & amortization
help: Provider-reported non-cash depreciation field. Check the filing for amortization scope before using it as a full D&A figure.

label: Net receivables
help: Amounts customers owe at the reporting date, net of allowances.

label: Inventory
help: Inventory carrying value at the reporting date; industry comparability matters.

label: Accounts payable
help: Reported supplier obligations at the reporting date.

label: Retained earnings
help: Cumulative retained accounting earnings, not cash available to shareholders.

label: Revenue
help: Sales recognized in this reporting period, before expenses.

label: Net income
help: Reported profit after costs, interest and taxes. One-time gains can affect comparability.

label: FCF · OCF less capex
help: AURYN calculation: operating cash flow minus the source’s capital expenditure field, using matching periods. Company-reported FCF may additionally deduct software investment, intangibles or lease payments. These definitions are not interchangeable.

label: Diluted EPS
help: Reported diluted earnings per share. TTM EPS is withheld where a consistent split-adjusted per-share history is not available.

label: Operating margin
help: Operating profit divided by revenue. Profitability is not by itself proof of a durable moat.

label: FCF margin
help: Free cash flow divided by revenue. Reinvestment and working capital affect this measure.

label: Gross profit
help: Revenue after cost of sales. If derived, revenue and cost use the same filing and period.

label: Gross margin
help: Gross profit divided by revenue. Compare within relevant industries.

label: Operating income
help: Profit from operations before interest and taxes.

label: Net margin
help: Net income divided by revenue; exceptional gains can inflate this figure.

label: Research & development
help: Reported research and development expense; capitalized development is not included.

label: Operating cash flow
help: Cash generated by operations including working-capital movements.

label: Capital expenditure
help: Cash purchases of property, plant and equipment; not all acquisitions or intangible investment.

label: FCF per diluted share
help: FCF divided by weighted-average diluted shares for the same period. TTM uses a day-weighted average of quarter shares.

label: FCF less SBC / share
help: AURYN sensitivity: (FCF minus stock compensation) divided by weighted diluted shares. This is a non-GAAP analytical adjustment, not reported FCF or a direct estimate of dilution.

label: Stock compensation
help: Reported share-based compensation expense; compare with revenue and net share-count changes.

label: SBC / revenue
help: Stock compensation divided by revenue; a cost indicator, not the rate of shareholder dilution.

label: Share repurchases
help: Cash spent repurchasing shares. Repurchases may offset issuance rather than reduce outstanding shares.

label: Dividends paid
help: Reported cash dividends. Absence in the connected facts does not mean zero dividends.

label: Cash conversion
help: Operating cash flow divided by positive net income. Working-capital timing can make this volatile.

label: Capex / revenue
help: Cash capital expenditure as a percentage of sales.

label: Cash & equivalents
help: Reported period-end cash and cash equivalents; restricted cash and investments may be separate.

label: Reported total debt
help: Mapped total-debt disclosure. Missing data is not treated as no debt; lease coverage depends on the reported tag.

label: Debt less cash
help: Reported total debt minus cash from the same period and currency. Negative means net cash on this definition.

label: Total assets
help: Reported assets at period end; balance-sheet figures are not summed for TTM.

label: Total liabilities
help: Reported liabilities, including obligations beyond interest-bearing debt.

label: Shareholders’ equity
help: Reported equity attributable to shareholders.

label: Current ratio
help: Current assets divided by positive current liabilities for the same reporting date.

label: Debt / equity
help: Debt divided by positive equity. Withheld when equity is zero or negative.

label: Interest coverage
help: Operating income divided by positive reported interest expense. Missing or zero expense does not imply unlimited coverage.

label: Diluted average shares
help: Weighted-average diluted shares over the period, not the current share count. Quarterly averages are not derived by subtracting YTD averages.
